news.title: Germany says new dMAT will not be a “pass-fail barrier” for Indian students
news.summary_en: The German Embassy and DAAD say the Digital Master Test will become an additional component of APS documentation for selected Indian master's applicants, giving German universities a comparable academic reference point while helping applicants demonstrate their academic strengths.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: UK: Pakistani market shrinking ahead of September intake
news.summary_en: The number of Pakistani students accepting a place or being issued a CAS from a UK university has fallen sharply yar on year, according to preliminary data from Enroly.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Can benchmarking help US universities navigate internationalisation headwinds?
news.summary_en: A new US internationalisation study aims to equip institutions with benchmarking data to inform strategy and strengthen internal advocacy, amid mounting sector challenges.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Southeast Asia in flux: UK told “era of the mega market is over”
news.summary_en: Southeast Asia remains a growth region for international student mobility, but UK universities were warned they can no longer rely on prestige or a handful of major source markets to sustain recruitment.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: India on the rise as a study destination for local students
news.summary_en: As the ‘big four’ study destinations continue to lose market share, new data reveals a surge in Indian students opting for in-country postgraduate education.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Scottish minister urges UK government to “get behind” international higher education
news.summary_en: International collaboration has “never been more important” and the UK must “stand up for the benefits of higher education as a true UK asset”, Scotland’s tertiary education minister told the BUILA conference in Glasgow.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: England to push on with international student levy despite sector’s concerns
news.summary_en: The UK government is pressing ahead with plans to introduce a levy on the international student fee income of English universities despite concerns raised by the sector.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Australian regulators raise compliance concerns over agent commission ban
news.summary_en: Australia’s higher education and vocational education regulators have issued a joint sector alert warning providers over practices that may undermine a ban on education agent commissions linked to onshore overseas student transfers.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Made Impact aims to “change the narrative” with UN summit
news.summary_en: The inaugural Made Impact Summit 2026 will take place at the United Nations in New York, it has been confirmed.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert
